xy_tolerance: TEB computeVelocityCommands reads GoalChecker.getTolerances and sets cfg_->goal_tolerance.xy_goal_tolerance from pose_tolerance.position.x; actual checker is .30m
yaw_tolerance: This port has no native yaw_goal_tolerance parameter; Nav2 goal checker handles actual 10deg yaw tolerance
undeclared_queries: FollowPath.xy_goal_tolerance and FollowPath.yaw_goal_tolerance return null; not used to claim runtime verification
